runtime.title: Daily agent package maintenance
notes: Adds bounded public-registry version discovery and pinned update plans for the stable admin release family and directly declared website harness. Incomplete releases, drift, local overrides and breaking updates are held for review.

Adds idempotent existing-installation maintenance instructions and new-installation check scripts. Preparation and testing follow existing publishing permissions; no scheduler or production action is activated.

contracts.title: Typed agent maintenance reports and plans
notes: Adds the shared package-family, status, release identity and prepare-and-test plan contract used by the admin and website daily maintenance tooling.

initializer.title: Initialize with daily maintenance guidance
notes: Pins runtime 1.5.0 so new admins receive the update-check script and agent maintenance instructions. Scaffolding does not activate an external schedule or change deployment authority.
